name: Archery bow
summary: Recurve archery bow standing upright with the string and an arrow nocked; anim draw pulls the string back and forth.

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the bottom tip rests on y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; hero size: at s = 1 the bow is about 760 px tall and 300 px wide

params.name: anim
params.note: draw = the string is pulled back and released in a loop

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the arrow points left
